message.content: {"note_claim": "The claim that Chelsea Clinton received USAID money through the Clinton Foundation, with millions spent on her wedding, is false (debunked by fact checks).", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "No tangible evidence has yet turned up documenting that the cost of Chelsea Clinton's 2010 wedding to investment banker Marc Mezvinsky was paid out of Clinton Foundation coffers", "reason": "The 2018 Snopes piece addresses the wedding-payment rumor (rated Unproven, with Clinton denying it) but says nothing about USAID, the $82 million, or DOGE, so it only indirectly supports the note's debunking."}

parsed.note_claim: The claim that Chelsea Clinton received USAID money through the Clinton Foundation, with millions spent on her wedding, is false (debunked by fact checks).
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: No tangible evidence has yet turned up documenting that the cost of Chelsea Clinton's 2010 wedding to investment banker Marc Mezvinsky was paid out of Clinton Foundation coffers
parsed.reason: The 2018 Snopes piece addresses the wedding-payment rumor (rated Unproven, with Clinton denying it) but says nothing about USAID, the $82 million, or DOGE, so it only indirectly supports the note's debunking.
